[Gruesome and Grim] [Exert] — Play a character with cost 4 or less for free. They gain Rush. At the end of the turn, banish them. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

527739.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Yzma.)
[Cruel Irony] When you play this character, shuffle another chosen character card into their player’s deck. That player draws 2 cards.

527740.Description: [For All Eternity] [Exert], [Exert] one of your characters — Exert chosen character.
527740.Flavor Text: Just a standard form, nothing to worry about.

527741.Description: [Hurtling Hedgehog] Banish this item — Chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

527744.Flavor Text:
"It’s not just fancy horses and swinging a sword around, you know! A true master must use his brain as well as his blade.”
—Merlin

527745.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[You're in My World] Whenever this character quests, chosen opposing character can't quest during their next turn.

527746.Description: [Yes, I'm Intimidating] While one or more opponents have no cards in their hands, this character gets +3 Strength.

527747.Flavor Text: "What’s the rush, Rob? Take a load off! There’s plenty of time to go lookin’ for lore lost in that crazy ink."

527748.Description: [Coming, Your Most Lugubriousness] While this character has 5 Strength or more, he gets +2 Lore.
527748.Flavor Text:
"Get a move on! I'm a busy god, lots to do—meetings, curses, a little light scheming."
—Hades

527749.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Take That!] Whenever you play an action, this character gets +2 Strength this turn.
[Who's Next?] While this character has 7 Strength or more, he gets +2 Lore.

527750.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
527750.Flavor Text: “I’ve outdone myself this time! Soon I will have everything I deserve. Riches . . . power . . . an entire kingdom at my feet!”

527751.Flavor Text: Finding your true self will set your heart aglow.

527752.Flavor Text: “The bees are buzzin' in the tree to make some honey just for me!"

527753.Flavor Text: "If you see any hungry faces, send ’em my way.”

527754.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Phooey!] This character gets +1 Lore for each 1 damage on him.

527755.Description: Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
527755.Flavor Text:
"This isn’t how most cat-and-mouse games go, is it, Dr. Dawson?”
—Basil

527756.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Lady Tremaine.)
[Power to Rule at Last] When you play this character, each opponent chooses and banishes one of their characters.
527756.Flavor Text: The twelfth Rule of Villainy: If you don't have a throne, take one.

527757.Description: [This Shouldn't Take Long] [Exert], Banish this character — Banish chosen character.
527757.Flavor Text: “I don't need swords to beat you. They just make it more fun.”

527758.Description:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Queen of Hearts.)
[Let the Game Begin] Whenever one of your characters challenges another character, you may draw a card.

527759.Description: Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
527759.Flavor Text: A good friend is always ready to roll.

527760.Description: Chosen damaged character gets +3 Strength this turn.
527760.Flavor Text:
"No one can have a higher opinion of you than I have, and I think you're a slimy, contemptible sewer rat!”
—Basil

527761.Flavor Text: Like so much other lore, Peter Pan's dagger was safe in the Great Illuminary until the flood.

527763.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

527764.Description: [Never, Ever Lose Sight] When this character is banished, you may put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

527765.Description: [I'm a Fast Learner] When you play this character, remove up to 1 damage from chosen character of yours.
527765.Flavor Text: She may be young, but she’s got the spirit of a true leader.

527766.Description: [Hide and Seek] While you have an item in play, this character gains Resist +1 and Ward. (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1. Opponents can’t choose this character except to challenge.)

527767.Flavor Text:
Pooh: “Isn’t there anybody here at all?”
Rabbit: “Nobody!”
Pooh: “Somebody’s there . . . because somebody must have said ‘Nobody.’”

527768.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

527769.Description: [Hunny Pot] Whenever this character quests, you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell facedown.
527769.Flavor Text: When he thought, he thought in the most thoughtful way he could think.

527770.Description: [Looking for This?] Whenever you play another item, you may pay 1 Ink to draw a card.
527770.Flavor Text: The solution you need could be just a few adjustments away.

527771.Description: [Flight Cabin] Your exerted characters gain Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
527771.Flavor Text:
"Flight 3759 boarding now! Let’s go get that lore!"
—Orville

527772.Description: [Shield Another] Whenever one of your other characters would be dealt damage, put that many damage counters on this character instead.
527772.Flavor Text: "You'll have to go through me first."

527773.Description: [We Have a Choice] When you play this character, you may banish chosen item.

527775.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Scout Leader] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may deal 2 damage to chosen character.

527776.Description: [Payback] While this character has no damage, he gets +4 Strength.
527776.Flavor Text: In this new world, the crown could finally be his.

527777.Description: [Make it Shine] When you play this character, chosen character gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
527777.Flavor Text: Even with a hauling weight of “seriously, a lot,” it can only do so much in a magical flood.

527778.Flavor Text:
"Don’t be fooled by the folksy peasant look.”
—Kuzco

527779.Flavor Text: “My place is going be special, with great food to fill people’s bellies and hot jazz to feed their souls!”

527780.Description: [Arm Yourself] 1 Ink, Banish this item — Chosen character gains Challenger +3 this turn. (They get +3 Strength while challenging.)

527797.Description: [Student] Whenever this character quests, you may return another chosen character of yours to your hand to gain 2 lore.

527798.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Blades] This character can challenge ready characters.

527799.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Snow White.)
[Wishes Come True] Whenever this character quests, you may return a character card from your discard to your hand.

527800.Description: [Second Wind] Whenever an opposing character is damaged, you may ready this character.

527802.Description: Singer 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)

528107.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[I Win, I Win!] When you play this character, banish her or return another 2 chosen characters of yours to your hand.

528108.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Take That!] Whenever you play an action, this character gets +2 Strength this turn.
[Who's Next?] While this character has 7 Strength or more, he gets +2 Lore.

528109.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Lady Tremaine.)
[Power to Rule at Last] When you play this character, each opponent chooses and banishes one of their characters.

528110.Description: [Don't Insult My Intelligence] Whenever one of your characters challenges another character, gain 1 lore.

528111.Description:
[Good Advice] Your other characters gain Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[What Did I Do?] While this character has 10 Strength or more, she gets +4 Lore.

528112.Description: [I Trust You] Whenever this character quests, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
528112.Flavor Text: No matter her shape, you can't mistake her heart.

528113.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Hercules.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
528113.Flavor Text: A good guy to have around when something wrecks your inkworks.

528644.Description: Set of 4 Minnie Mouse - Wide-Eyed Diver puzzle insert cards.

597095.Description: [Squeak] Whenever you play a Floodborn character, if you used Shift to play them, each opponent chooses and discards a card.
597095.Flavor Text:
"There's a lot of nuance to squirrel."
—Kronk

618771.Description:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)

(This card was officially reprinted with updated artwork.)
618771.Flavor Text: The power of ice may not stop the flood, but it will help protect Lorcana.
